_note: SYNTHETIC replay fixture for the weather_naive_ensemble / weather_calibrated_ensemble A/B. Every history row, forecast, book and settlement is generated by a seeded script (truth = sinusoid + N(0,1.2); per-model forecast = truth + bias + N(0, sd) with biases {gfs +3F, ecmwf 0, icon -2F, gem 0, meteofrance +1F, ukmo 0, jma +4F} and sds {0.8, 0.9, 1.6, 3.0, 1.8, 1.7, 3.0} F, scaled by 1/1.8 for Celsius cities) so that one branch of the measurement is exercised per event: adequate calibration (NYC, 40 days; Hong Kong, 25 days, one-decimal source), underpowered calibration (London, 5 days), unknown city, same-day lead, non-contiguous ladder, missing forecast, empty book, a settlement the calibrated lane wins and one it loses, still-pending settlements. It is not market data, the biases are invented, and it proves arithmetic only: it carries no evidence for or against the hypothesis.

schema.history[]: calibration samples {city, date, unit, precision, truth_lo, truth_hi, truth_value, forecasts{model: value}}
schema.steps[].open_events[]: {slug, event_id, title, legs[{market_id, label, bids[[price,size]], asks[[price,size]]}]}
schema.steps[].forecasts: {'<city_key>:<date>': {model: day-ahead max}} served by the fixture forecast source
schema.steps[].settlements: {slug: closed event in the same shape with legs[].resolved} served by event_by_slug
